//engines: firebase-admin@14 requires Node >= 22. On an older runtime it fails to load and every route that touches it (auth, /book, /dashboard, admin) returns an empty 500, while prerendered pages keep working. Written as '22.x' because Vercel matches its documented major-version form and ignored the '>=22.0.0' range.
//overrides: firebase-admin -> jwks-rsa does `require('jose')`, but jose@6 is ESM-only. That require only works on runtimes with require(esm) enabled: it loads on Node 24 locally and throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on Vercel, taking down firebase-admin/auth and every route behind it. jose@5 ships a CJS build and still exports the two functions jwks-rsa uses (importJWK, exportSPKI). Remove once jwks-rsa imports jose asynchronously.
